name: documesh
description: Federated developer documentation search across 18 vendors with version-cited, license-attributed results.

skills.name: search-docs
skills.description: Search developer documentation across Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel, Kubernetes, React, PyTorch, and 13 more vendors

skills.name: explain-error
skills.description: Match an error message or stack trace to the closest documentation sections
skills.when_to_use: When the user pastes an error, exception, or log output and needs help

skills.name: list-vendors
skills.description: List all vendors in the mesh with their license and attribution requirements
skills.when_to_use: When the user asks what documentation sources are available or needs license info
